description.value: Glover Community Nature Park is a forested nature reserve operated by the Comox Valley Regional District on Vancouver Island. It offers a natural woodland setting for quiet recreation and wildlife observation close to the Comox Valley communities. Touring cyclists looking for a green break or a short trail walk would find it a low-key stop between destinations.
